name: @qf-jarvis/jarvis-os
description: Jarvis OS — the premium operator control plane for QF Jarvis (JOS-01A, docs/architecture/jarvis-os.md). A POWERLESS read surface: it renders the repository's own baseline behind an authenticated owner session and a governed control-plane boundary, and holds no business authority. QuickFurno Core remains authoritative for vendors, customers, packages, pricing, payments, consent and commercial outcomes; n8n executes; Meta delivers. This application creates no approval, sends no communication, invokes no n8n or provider, mutates no Core or Jarvis durable state, and reaches no database.
